The first-item row is Yasuo's crit/Shieldbow spike; 2+ items Pantheon recovers via unblockable all-in and CC on his R.

audit.why: First item is Yasuo's spike (crit + Shieldbow), level 6 is yours (Grand Starfall vs an R that needs a knock-up he cannot self-generate on you). suspectName 'Grand Starfall' is a false positive — real R name.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[1] calls Grand Starfall 'point-and-click' — it is ground-targeted. breakdown.cooldowns has no numbers despite Wind Wall's 25-17s CD and 4s duration being the matchup's defining timer.
audit.why: Kit: Wind Wall 25/23/21/19/17s, blocks projectiles 4s — eats your Q spear and R comet path claims aside, your W dash-stun is targeted and passes it. Yasuo Q 4s base, E cannot re-dash same target for a few seconds, R 70-30s needs an Airborne target.
audit.corrected: Numbers written into breakdown.cooldowns; 'point-and-click' corrected to 'ground-targeted'.

edits.before: First item spike: the stun-spear rotation deletes squishies. Last call before scaling lanes wake.
edits.after: His window: the crit item plus Shieldbow lifeline can flip an all-in you'd win pre-item. Wait it out.

edits.before: Late Pantheon is a starting pistol: R the flank, stun the carry, block the counter — and let the team finish what the spear started.
edits.after: You recover late: the W-stun setup deletes his squishy frame, your CC denies the R he needs Airborne targets for.

edits.before: - Yasuo Wind Wall: matchup-defining — Blocks every projectile for its duration — hold your poke until it is spent. Step up only on its downtime. - Budget E Aegis Assault for emergencies and the R for opportunities — never swap them.
edits.after: - Yasuo Wind Wall: 25s at rank 1, 17s max — it eats your spear for 4s, but your W dash-stun is targeted and passes it. Step up in its downtime. - Budget E Aegis Assault (22s) for emergencies and the R for opportunities — never swap them.

edits.before: W the step-up, empowered-Q the stun, E the answer, walk — the full toll he paid for one last-hit.
edits.after: Open Aegis into his EQ flurry — the frontal block eats the whirlwind knock-up and his crit autos.

edits.before: Spending the all-in into a held escape at even HP — Pantheon trades are loans; defaulting on one funds his whole comeback.
edits.after: Shoved waves are R tickets — a Yasuo scaling freely while you idle mid is a loss you chose; leave and tax the map instead.
